_comment: Maps a game sound to one or more files from the owner-supplied retro/platformer sound pack (assets/audio/pack/<name>.ogg); a name starting with @ is one of the game's own effects (assets/audio/<name>.wav). One is picked at random each time (never the same one twice in a row). Delete an entry to fall back to the built-in synthesized sound of the same name. Edit freely, no code change needed. The game plays the mastered copy (assets/audio/mastered/, tools/audio/master_sfx.py) when there is one. Grunts and the bee buzz stay synthesized (they are pitched per character).

_build82._comment: Build 83 audio polish changed these entries; put them back to restore the Build 82 sounds.
